name: ham-net-assistant
description: Net-management web app for college amateur-radio clubs: repeaters, scheduled nets, live check-ins, FCC-friendly logs, participation stats, and a Discord bridge.
author: Atvriders
//test: The JWT_SECRET in the `test` script is a throwaway 64-hex value, never used by any deployment. It has to satisfy apps/api/src/env.ts (>= 32 chars, no placeholder words such as 'secret' or 'change-me'): the previous `dev-test-secret-long-enough` is now rejected, and any test file that reaches env.ts without importing test/helpers.ts first would abort the whole suite.

scripts.build: npm -w @hna/shared run build && npm -w @hna/api run build && npm -w @hna/web run build
scripts.test: JWT_SECRET=6d1c05e7f38b49a2ce7014b8d5f3a96201e8b7c4d90f523a6e18cb47f0d29a35 npm -w @hna/shared run test && JWT_SECRET=6d1c05e7f38b49a2ce7014b8d5f3a96201e8b7c4d90f523a6e18cb47f0d29a35 npm -w @hna/api run test && npm -w @hna/web run test
scripts.typecheck: npm -w @hna/shared run typecheck && npm -w @hna/api run typecheck && npm -w @hna/web run typecheck
